Olivia (Support): Customer on acct acct_8b9 says they applied WELCOME50 via the customer portal, then an admin attached TRIAL2026 via the admin tool. Portal showed both stacked but account now only has TRIAL2026 and balance is lower than expected. They're upset (lost ~$200). Any ideas?
Ravi (Billing): Can you share exact account id and approximate time? Also whether they used portal UI or API.
Olivia (Support): acct_8b9, happened ~2024-06-12 21:03 UTC. Portal UI -> they clicked "Apply promo" then minutes later said they talked to our sales rep who used admin portal to attach trial. I can share request logs.
Sam (Platform): Quick thought: admin attach endpoint historically replaced the promos array instead of appending. Portal apply likely calls the append endpoint. If admin call uses a replace/upsert semantics it would remove the earlier code.
Olivia (Support): I pulled logs. Posting minimal repro-ish snippets: 
```
# Portal apply (frontend -> promotions service)
POST /api/v1/accounts/acct_8b9/promos
{"code":"WELCOME50"}
200 OK
```
```
# Admin tool (internal POST)
POST /admin/accounts/attach_promo
{"account_id":"acct_8b9","promo":"TRIAL2026"}
200 OK
```
PromoService logs: "PromoService: applied promo TRIAL2026 to acct_8b9 (replaced 1 existing)"
PromoBot: :information_source: PromoService: applied promo TRIAL2026 to acct_8b9 (replaced [WELCOME50])
Sam (Platform): That log string shows the admin path used replace semantics. That matches the customer report. Looks like a semantics mismatch rather than DB corruption or billing math.
Eden (Engineer): I see the admin endpoint uses `SET promotions = :payload` semantics in the code path. Historically there was a migration to support explicit sets for enterprise accounts, but nobody added the admin UI guard to call the merge endpoint.
Ravi (Billing): For remediation — can we reapply WELCOME50 retroactively and credit the $200? We need an audit trail.
Eden (Engineer): I can run a one-off job to reattach WELCOME50 and recalc token balance, but need ops sign-off. Steps: 1) fetch prior audit entry for WELCOME50 application; 2) run merge-on-write script that inserts WELCOME50 if missing; 3) recalc prepaid credits and post audit.
Olivia (Support): Customer requests ETA and proof that credits will be returned. They want it within 24h.
Sam (Platform): Recommend temporary mitigation: block admin UI from calling replace endpoint until we publish fix. Also add a server-side guard: if request origin = admin-ui and payload is single promo, call merge API instead of set.
Ravi (Billing): I'm authorizing emergency fix for this account. Olivia, file a formal billing ticket and include customer contact. We'll credit them and include notes.
Eden (Engineer): I'll prepare a rollback script and a PR to change admin-client behavior to use `POST /promos/merge` instead of `SET`, plus add an integ test for concurrent applies. ETA for PR -> 3-6h, deploy -> after code review + canary within 6-12h.
Olivia (Support): Sharing the billing ticket to the customer now (SUP-2419). I'll follow up when credit is restored.
Sam (Platform): Repro steps for engineering: 1) Send portal apply: POST /api/v1/accounts/{id}/promos {code: X} 2) Immediately send admin attach: POST /admin/accounts/attach_promo {promo: Y} 3) Observe DB promotions contains only Y. This reproduces reliably when calls overlap within ~200ms window.
Eden (Engineer): Confirmed locally — race due to replace vs append. Also will add DB-level merge transaction to be safe.
Ravi (Billing): Once Eden posts PR link, I'll approve the emergency ops run for acct_8b9.
PromoBot: :white_check_mark: Created support ticket SUP-2419 and ops run request OR-885.
Olivia (Support): Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer with the plan and escalate if they push for faster resolution.
Sam (Platform): After this, let's do a short postmortem and add a small policy doc for admin endpoints so future behavior is explicit.
Eden (Engineer): Will attach root cause and timeline to SUP-2419 after the fix.
